notes.title: Fix the save file issue and adjust the difficulty appropriately
notes.content:
1: Fixed the issue where some players occasionally cannot save the game.
2: Appropriately reduced the game difficulty.
3: Added a prompt when players may get stuck in the later stages due to extreme point allocation.
4: Fixed the occasional incorrect display of values such as players' HP and ATK.

notes.title: Fix bugs related to monster details
notes.content:
Fixed the bug where the game doesn't pause when opening the monster detail interface, which could cause a crash with a certain probability after switching scenes if the character continues walking.
Fixed the bug where the monster detail interface can still be opened when some dialogues are active, resulting in overlapping interfaces.
